content.text: ## PHASE: builder ## ISSUE: 220 ### Issue Details ## Issue #220 ## What to build Resolve two distinct bugs in the Catalog Management feature: (1) 404 errors on API endpoints for "Bicycle Templates" and "Labor Services", and (2) a duplicate euro symbol (`€€`) displayed in the "Add New Labor Service" modal input field. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] `/api/labor-services` routes correctly to the existing backend handler (fix route prefix mismatch: should be mounted under `/repairs`) - [ ] `/api/bicycle-templates` API endpoints are created and functional (search, fetch by ID, deactivate) - [ ] "Add New Labor Service" modal shows a single `€` symbol before the input value - [ ] Currency input accepts decimal values greater than `9.99` without truncation or validation errors ## Blocked by None - can start immediately ## Agent Findings ### Archivist — 2026-05-30 #### AC #1: Labor Services Route Fix (Warning → Resolved) **Root cause**: Frontend calls `/api/labor-services` but backend serves at `/api/repairs/labor-services`. - **Fix location**: `client/src/features/catalog/labor-services/LaborServicesPage.tsx` lines 54, 63, 72, 81, 149 - **Action**: Update all fetch URLs from `/api/labor-services` to `/api/repairs/labor-services` - **Backend already correct**: `server/src/routes/repairs.ts:195` mounts labor services under `/repairs` via `app.route(/repairs, repairsRoutes)` in `server/src/routes/index.ts` #### AC #2: Bicycle Templates API (Critical → Resolved) **Frontend already exists**: `client/src/features/catalog/bicycle-templates/BicycleTemplatesPage.tsx` — makes these API calls: | Method | Endpoint | Purpose | Expected Response Shape | |--------|----------|---------|----------------------| | GET | `/api/bicycle-templates?search=...` | List/search templates | `{ templates: [...], total: number }` | | POST | `/api/bicycle-templates` | Create template | Created BicycleTemplateDetail | | GET | `/api/bicycle-templates/:id` | Get single template detail | BicycleTemplateDetail | | PATCH | `/api/bicycle-templates/:id` | Update template | Updated BicycleTemplateDetail | | PATCH | `/api/bicycle-templates/:id/deactivate` | Deactivate template | `{ success: true }` | **Database schema exists**: `server/src/db/schema.ts:126` — `bicycleTemplates` table with fields: `id`, `brand`, `model`, `description`, `basePriceNet` (cents), `isActive` (boolean). **Implementation pattern to follow**: Mirror `server/src/routes/products.ts`: - **Route file**: Create `server/src/routes/bicycle-templates.ts` (new file, flat in routes/ alongside products.ts, repairs.ts) - **Service layer**: Create `server/src/services/bicycle-template.service.ts` with functions: `browseTemplates()`, `getTemplateById()`, `createTemplate()`, `updateTemplate()`, `deactivateTemplate()` - **Register route**: Add `app.route(/bicycle-templates, bicycleTemplatesRoutes)` to `server/src/routes/index.ts` - **Validation schemas**: Define inline in the route file (like products.ts does with Zod) — no shared validation needed for this feature yet **Reference files for pattern**: - Route: `server/src/routes/products.ts` (flat Hono routes, zValidator middleware, error handling) - Service: `server/src/services/product.service.ts` (Drizzle ORM queries, DTO shapes, error classes) - Test: `server/src/routes/__tests__/products.test.ts` (Vitest integration tests using `app.request()`) #### AC #3 & #4: Currency Input Duplicate € Symbol (Resolved) **Root cause confirmed**: Two sources of the euro symbol: 1. Component renders `€` at `client/src/components/ui/CurrencyInput.tsx:60` 2. `formatCentsToEuro()` in `client/src/shared/lib/utils.ts:15` returns `"€X.XX"` (includes € prefix) **Fix**: Remove the `€` wrapper from CurrencyInput and let `formatCentsToEuro()` handle display formatting.
